Phase 2B

Before Step 1

Prepare your Move

One-time setup
  1. Sync or back up your notebooks first. Enabling Developer Mode performs a factory reset and removes data currently stored on the Move.
  2. Enable Developer Mode on the Move. Open Settings → General → Paper Tablet → Software → Advanced → Developer Mode, then follow the reset and setup instructions shown on the device.
  3. Find the Developer password after setup. Open Settings → General → Help → About → Copyrights and Licenses. Under General Information, find the username and randomly generated password.
  4. Connect the Move to this computer by USB. Keep it awake and leave this information page available while installing. The usual USB address is 10.11.99.1.

These paths follow reMarkable's official Developer Mode documentation.

Important

Unofficial software disclaimer

Paper Agent is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by reMarkable or OpenAI.

It installs and modifies software available through Developer Mode. This weakens the device's normal security protections; firmware updates may disable custom software, and modifications can affect stability, support eligibility, or locally stored data. Paper Agent backs up files it manages, but cannot guarantee recovery of unrelated device data.

Optional cleanup

Uninstall Paper Agent

Safely removes Paper Agent's notebook integration, background service, and Settings app. Shared XOVI, AppLoad, Node/Pi, ChatGPT sign-in, user settings, and backups are preserved.

XOVI and AppLoad are never removed here because other reMarkable tools may depend on them, including copies installed before Paper Agent. Full removal is offered only for components whose installation source was recorded by Paper Agent Installer.

No uninstall operation requested.
